name: Context Pacer
description: Paces agents that gather with tools: a status line on each gathering result, with nudges to write notes and to finish from them. Never blocks a tool.

agents.description: Agent ids to pace. Empty (the default) means the plugin does nothing until configured.

gatherTools.description: Tools whose results count as gathering and get the status line.

noteTools.description: Tools that can write a note.

notesPath.description: A write counts as a note when its path contains this segment.

noteEvery.description: Ask for a note once this many gathering results pass without one.

wrapUpAt.description: Share of the context budget at which the line says to finish from the notes.

maxRuns.description: Most runs tracked at once; the oldest is dropped beyond this.
